## About
This is the Tire Rack distribution center at 3015 Long Lake Rd in Roseville. You research and order your tires, then swing by to pick them up instead of waiting on shipping.
Customers who pick up locally get a discount. We don't mount or balance tires here, so plan to have a local shop install them.
We're open weekdays and hold a 4.5 rating from 279 Google reviews.

## Services
- Local pickup discount: Pick up your order at our Roseville location and save a little.
- Tires bought online, picked up the same day: One reviewer bought two sets of tires online and picked them up in Roseville the same day.
- Tires delivered from Roseville: One reviewer had their order sent from Roseville to Hinckley, Minnesota, and the tires were delivered in less than a day.

## FAQ
Q: Do you install tires?
A: No. You'll need to arrange mounting and balancing with another shop after you pick up your tires.

Q: Is there a discount for picking up?
A: Yes. Picking up locally comes with a small discount.

Q: What happens when I arrive?
A: One reviewer called to say they'd arrived and the tires were brought out in a few minutes.
